navidad.temporada.no: It's not Christmas season yet (December 1 to January 6).
navidad.regalo.ayuda: Right-click to open it: what will you get?
navidad.pinata.ayuda: Right-click a ceiling to hang it (or the floor). Hit it until it breaks: best with the stick and blindfolded!
navidad.pinata.casi: Hit it, hit it! Almost there...
navidad.venda.ayuda: Right-click: covers your eyes and makes you a bit dizzy (just like at a posada).
navidad.caja.ayuda: Place it and right-click it with what you want to give. Use a name tag: only that person can open it.
navidad.caja.vacia: The box is empty: click it with what you want to give.
navidad.caja.envuelta: 🎁 Gift wrapped! Anyone can open it now... or set "To" with a name tag.
navidad.caja.no_es_tuyo: This gift is for %s (from %s). No peeking!
navidad.calendario.espera: The little doors open from December 1. %s days to go.
navidad.calendario.ya: You already opened door %s. Come back tomorrow!
navidad.calendario.feliz: 🎄 Merry Christmas! You opened %s of 24 doors.
navidad.calendario.fingido: Pretend December day: %s (0 = the real one)
navidad.ropa.ayuda: Right-click to put it on or take it off (shows over your skin).
item.navidad.disco_navidad.desc: We Wish You a Merry Christmas - music box
navidad.adornos.ayuda: In a stonecutter it turns into any Christmas decoration.
navidad.campana.ayuda: Ring it at night... if you dare. It summons the Krampus.
navidad.campana.dia: The bell rings, but nobody answers during the day...
navidad.krampus.llega: ⛓ Chains rattle in the dark... the Krampus is coming for the naughty ones!
navidad.krampus.vencido: 🎄 You defeated the Krampus! Christmas is saved!
navidad.reno.amigo: 🦌 The reindeer is your friend now! Right-click with an empty hand to ride it.
navidad.reno.timido: The reindeer is shy... give it some carrots first.
navidad.jengibre.burla2: 🍪 "I'm made of ginger and I'm faster than you!"
navidad.jengibre.burla3: 🍪 "Not even Mrs. Claus could catch me!"
npc.navidad.santa.hola1: Ho, ho, ho! Have you been good this year?
npc.navidad.santa.hola2: The elves work day and night. Will you lend a hand?
npc.navidad.santa.hola3: They say the Krampus is on the loose... be careful at night.
npc.navidad.senora_claus.hola1: Come in, the cookies just came out of the oven!
npc.navidad.senora_claus.hola2: A nice hot chocolate for the cold, right?
npc.navidad.senora_claus.hola3: If you see a gingerbread man running... he escaped again.
npc.navidad.duende_juguetero.hola1: We take candy here! The best toys at the North Pole.
npc.navidad.duende_juguetero.hola2: A piñata? I have seven-pointed ones!
npc.navidad.duende_juguetero.hola3: Bring me snowballs and I'll pay you in candy.
npc.navidad.duende_sastre.hola1: An ugly Christmas sweater for every occasion!
npc.navidad.duende_sastre.hola2: I make Santa's suit, did you know?
npc.navidad.duende_sastre.hola3: I need red and white wool. Lots of it!
npc.navidad.duende_renos.hola1: Reindeer love carrots. Give them three and they'll be your friends!
npc.navidad.duende_renos.hola2: At night, at Christmas, reindeer almost fly...
npc.navidad.duende_renos.hola3: Have you seen Lightning? He wandered off again.
mision.navidad.galletas_leche.desc: Oh, the journey is long... could you bring me gingerbread cookies and some milk?
mision.navidad.munecos.desc: Some snowmen turned evil and throw snowballs at everyone. Stop them!
mision.navidad.jengibre.desc: Three gingerbread men escaped from Mrs. Claus's kitchen. They're really fast!
mision.navidad.pinata.desc: A posada isn't complete without a piñata. Break one with your friends.
mision.navidad.regalos.desc: Christmas is about sharing: wrap gifts in boxes and have your friends open them.
mision.navidad.krampus.desc: The Krampus wants to ruin Christmas. If you face him, bring your friends... and come prepared.
mision.navidad.carta.desc: I get so many letters that I run out of paper. Could you bring paper and a feather?
mision.navidad.ingredientes.desc: I need sugar and cocoa for the hot chocolate. Can you help?
mision.navidad.pavo.desc: Christmas Eve dinner doesn't cook itself. Bring me cooked chicken and I'll give you turkey.
mision.navidad.horno.desc: I bake cookies every day. Bring me wheat and you get some.
mision.navidad.nieve.desc: We elves are having a snowball fight! Get us some snowballs.
mision.navidad.juguetes.desc: I ran out of wood and red paint. No toys without them!
mision.navidad.lana.desc: Santa's suit wears out every year. Bring me red and white wool.
mision.navidad.zanahorias.desc: The reindeer are hungry after flight practice.
mision.navidad.amigo_reno.desc: Make friends with a reindeer: give it carrots until it loves you.
navidad.aldea.lista: 🎄 Santa's village is ready! (%s blocks in %s ms)
navidad.rosca.muneco: 👶 %s found the baby figurine! Now they have to buy the tamales on February 2nd.
navidad.rosca.nada: Mmm... no baby figurine this time.
navidad.bengala.ayuda: Right-click to light it. Sparks in your hand!
navidad.fiesta.nochebuena: 🌟 It's Christmas Eve! Tonight Santa's sleigh will fly by several times...
navidad.fiesta.navidad: 🎄 Merry Christmas! Santa left a gift in your inventory.
navidad.fiesta.reyes: 👑 Happy Three Kings' Day! You got a rosca... will you find the baby figurine?
navidad.fiesta.trineo: 🛷 Sleigh bells! Look at the sky: it's Santa's sleigh!
navidad.fiesta.posada: 🪅 %s started a posada! Time to break the piñata!
navidad.fiesta.intercambio: 🎁 Gift exchange: you're giving a gift to %s. It's a secret, don't tell!
navidad.fiesta.intercambio_pocos: The gift exchange needs at least two players online.
navidad.fiesta.intercambio_listo: Gift exchange drawn among %s players (everyone got a secret message).
navidad.trineo_madera.ayuda: Put it on snow, hop on and slide downhill. Two can ride.
navidad.trineo_madera.ayuda2: A/D steer · W push · S brake · Shift get off. Slides even more on ice.
navidad.patines.ayuda: Much faster on ice; clumsy everywhere else.
navidad.uvas.ayuda: On New Year's, eat one with each bell toll and make a wish.
navidad.anio.prepara: 🍇 It's almost New Year! Get your 12 grapes ready: one per bell toll.
navidad.anio.doce: 🍇 You ate all 12 grapes in time! Your 12 wishes will come true (and you are very lucky for a while).
navidad.anio.algunas: 🍇 You ate %s grapes. Some luck for you!
navidad.anio.ninguna: You didn't eat any grapes... next year!
navidad.anio.nochevieja: 🍇 It's New Year's Eve! Here are your 12 grapes for midnight.
navidad.buzon.como: Write your letter to Santa in a book and quill and click the mailbox with it.
navidad.carta.vacaciones: Santa reads letters from December 1 to January 6.
navidad.carta.pendiente: Santa hasn't answered your other letter yet. Be patient!
navidad.carta.hoy: You already sent today's letter. Santa reads one a day per person.
navidad.carta.vacia: The letter is empty... write what you would like.
navidad.carta.enviada: ✉ Your letter flew off to the North Pole. Santa will read it tonight... be good!
navidad.carta.llego: 🎅 Santa's answer arrived! Check your inventory.
navidad.carta.llego_malo: 🎅 Santa's answer arrived... it feels heavy, like coal.
navidad.carta.resp.leida: I read your letter by the fireplace with a hot chocolate. My elves worked all night.
navidad.carta.resp.nada: I read your letter, but I couldn't quite tell what you wanted... so here's a surprise.
navidad.carta.resp.malo: I heard you hurt someone you shouldn't have. This year you get coal. There's still time to be good!
navidad.carta.resp.dificil: What you asked for is hard even for my elves, but here is something to make up for it.
navidad.carta.resp.bonito: Some wishes don't fit in a box. Those you take care of, with the people you love.
navidad.carrera.llega: 🛷 You reached the bottom in %s seconds!
navidad.muerdago: 🌿 %s and %s are under the mistletoe! Christmas hug 🤗
navidad.guerra.empieza: ❄ Snowball fight! It lasts %s seconds. Every hit on someone else is a point.
navidad.guerra.faltan: ❄ %s seconds left in the snowball fight.
navidad.guerra.fin: ❄ The snowball fight is over! The podium:
navidad.guerra.nadie: Nobody hit anybody... time to practice!
navidad.calcetin.lleno: ★ Santa left something in the stocking!
navidad.calcetin.vacio: The stocking is empty... Santa fills it again at night.
navidad.calcetin.carbon: Only coal... someone hurt who they shouldn't have.
navidad.calcetin.fuera: Out of season, stockings are just decoration.
navidad.calcetin.ayuda: In season, Santa fills it every night: right-click to take today's treats.
navidad.guerra.empieza_equipos: ❄ Team snowball fight! It lasts %s seconds. Hits on your own team don't count.
navidad.guerra.gana_equipo: The %s wins! The whole team gets a gift.
navidad.guerra.empate: It's a tie! No gift this time.
navidad.galletas.puestas: ★ You left cookies and milk for Santa. He'll come by tonight...
navidad.galletas.ya: Santa already has your cookies for tonight.
navidad.galletas.comidas: ★ Santa ate your cookies and left you a gift next to the plate!
navidad.deco.bebida_espera: Wait a little for another sip.
